evidence.title: Goldie: App Store screenshot generator for coding agents (and humans)
GitHub - software-mansion-labs/goldie: agentic app store previews and screenshots

name: Goldie
summary: CLI and studio that turn app flows into App Store and Google Play screenshots and preview videos.
description: Replays flows on an iOS simulator or Android emulator with argent, then frames the captures with a device bezel, background and headline and joins the clips into a preview video. Framework agnostic: works the same for SwiftUI, UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, React Native and Kotlin Multiplatform apps, and checks the result against the stores' upload rules.
contains: store screenshots and preview videos rendered from app flows
agent skill for coding agents plus a manual CLI
device bezels, backgrounds, headline templates and bundled fonts
checks output against App Store and Google Play upload rules
iPhone screenshots at 1320 x 2868; preview videos must run 15-30 s
scene and design choices saved in goldie.config.ts and goldie.design.json
